name: CostMate
description: Product costing for small manufacturers, workshops, and food producers. Know the true unit cost of every product you make — materials, machines, energy, and overhead included. Coming soon to Google Play and the App Store.

name: Confidary
description: A private journal that encrypts what you write on your device and ties every page to the people, places, and topics in it. Coming soon to Google Play and the App Store.

name: Service Next
description: Mobile technical service management running live on Odoo 19 — device tracking, quality control, quotes, invoices, expenses, and calls, from a phone.

name: Leave Plan
description: A leave and attendance module for Odoo 19 — no approval queue, entries are final the moment they're logged, with dates and summaries computed automatically.
